_meta.source: XYIAN (Kyle), 2026-09-07: 'we make exceptions for lower power levels if they are active daily and in our discord community'. Guild-owner policy; lib/guild-requirements.js changed in the same commit.
_meta.confidence: high — the guild owner stating his own admission policy.

requirements.xyian_official_power: XYIAN OFFICIAL — called XY for short (Guild ID 213797), the founding guild — requires 8M+ power. That floor is not absolute: XYIAN makes exceptions below it for players who are active daily and active in the Discord community, so a lower-power player should not be told no — point them to #guild-recruit-chat to say their power and show they are active.
requirements.projectxy_power: ProjectXY — called PXY for short (Guild ID 214890) — is XYIAN OFFICIAL's sister guild and requires 4M+ power (lowered from 6M+ on 2026-09-07). That floor is not absolute: exceptions are made below it for players who are active daily and active in the Discord community. PXY is where most new members land, and it is a competitive guild in its own right: same standards, same daily expectations, same ambition to climb to the top. One community, two guilds, both competitive — PXY is not a feeder, a starter guild, or a 'little brother'. Do not describe it as a place to start before moving on to XY.
requirements.power_exception: The power minimums (8M+ for XYIAN OFFICIAL, 4M+ for ProjectXY) are floors, not walls. Exceptions are made for lower-power players who are active daily in the game and active in the Discord community — activity is what the guilds actually value. A player below the floor should be told this and sent to #guild-recruit-chat with their power and a word about their activity, never turned away flatly.
